package splash // import "ubunatic.com/loom/examples/splash/splash"

Package splash is experimental; its API may change between releases. See
docs/APIStability.md for the package stability policy.

Package splash demonstrates the Harnez startup splash screen and transition
lifecycle.

FUNCTIONS

func Execute(ctx context.Context, args []string, out io.Writer) error
    Execute runs the splash example's cobra command against ctx/args/out,
    for callers that need explicit context and output control (e.g. tests).

func NewWidget(args []string) (loom.Widget, error)
    NewWidget builds the splash root widget from command-line arguments.

func NewWidgetFromOptions(opts Options) (loom.Widget, error)
    NewWidgetFromOptions builds the splash root widget from parsed options.

func Run(args []string) error
    Run runs the splash example with the given command-line args, writing to
    stdout, matching the Run(args []string) error signature shared by the other
    examples for loom-demo/loom-bench registration.


TYPES

type Options struct {
	Watch  bool
	Width  int
	Height int
}
    Options holds configuration for the splash widget and CLI execution.
